# Abhishek Stores and Mobile Shop (AS & MS)

> South Bengaluru's trusted doorstep mobile and laptop repair service.
> Certified technician comes to your home. Pay only after repair. 6-month warranty on all repairs.

## Business Identity

- **Full name**: Abhishek Stores and Mobile Shop
- **Known as**: AS & MS, AS and MS
- **Founded**: 2022
- **Founder**: Abhishek
- **Type**: Local repair shop + doorstep mobile & laptop repair service
- **Location**: No. 30, Khata No. 167, 13th Cross, GK Layout, Hosa Road, Electronic City, Bengaluru — 560100, Karnataka, India
- **Phone / WhatsApp**: +91 96062 46512
- **Website**: https://asandms.in
- **Hours**: 9 AM – 9 PM, 7 days a week (including Sundays and public holidays)
- **Google Maps**: https://maps.google.com/?cid=10149034131434432022
- **Google Rating**: 4.4 stars (31 verified reviews)
- **Devices repaired**: 500+
- **Service radius**: 20 km from GK Layout, Electronic City, Bengaluru
- **Languages**: English, Hindi, Kannada

## What Makes AS & MS Different

- Technician comes directly to the customer's home or office — no travel needed
- Price is communicated before any work starts — zero hidden charges
- Customer pays ONLY after the repair is complete and they are satisfied — no advance
- 6-month warranty on every repair — same issue recurs = fixed again at no cost
- Genuine, quality-certified spare parts used in all repairs
- Same-day repair for most issues (45 min for screen, 30 min for battery)
- Available 7 days a week, 9 AM to 9 PM

## Services

### Mobile Phone Repair
- URL: https://asandms.in/services/mobile-repair
- Description: Doorstep Android and iOS phone repair. All brands serviced.
- Covers: Screen replacement, battery replacement, charging port repair, speaker & mic repair,
  back glass replacement, water damage repair, software fix & flashing, camera repair,
  headphone jack repair, SIM/SD card slot repair
- Brands: iPhone, Samsung, OnePlus, Xiaomi, Redmi, Realme, Oppo, Vivo, Motorola, Google Pixel,
  Nokia, POCO, iQOO, Nothing, Tecno, Infinix, and more
- Pricing: Starting ₹199 (varies by brand, model, and damage severity)

### Laptop Repair
- URL: https://asandms.in/services/laptop-repair
- Description: Doorstep laptop repair for all major brands.
- Covers: Screen replacement, battery replacement, keyboard replacement, RAM upgrade,
  SSD/HDD upgrade & data migration, virus & malware removal, OS installation (Windows 10/11/Linux),
  cooling fan repair, hinge repair, motherboard diagnostics
- Brands: HP, Dell, Lenovo, Asus, Acer, Apple MacBook, Microsoft Surface
- Pricing: Starting ₹399 (varies by brand, model, and issue)

### Pickup & Delivery

- Covers: Same-day pickup, same-day return, WhatsApp tracking, secure handling, all device types

### SIM Cards at Home
- URL: https://asandms.in/services/sim-cards

### Mobile Loans / EMI
- URL: https://asandms.in/services/mobile-loans
- Description: Mobile phone purchase on EMI — loan application filled at home, phone delivered.
- Covers: EMI on new phones, all major brands, loan application assistance, exchange deals
- Processing: Approval and delivery within 1 hour

### Sell Your Phone
- URL: https://asandms.in/sell-phone
- Description: Buyback service for dead, damaged, cracked, or old mobile phones.
- Accepts: Dead/not turning on, cracked screen, water damaged, battery issues, hardware faults,
  old/unused phones — all brands
- Payment: Instant UPI, cash, or bank transfer on the spot
- Process: Send photos on WhatsApp → get quote in minutes → agree → hand over → instant payment

## Frequently Asked Questions

**Q: Do you repair phones and laptops at home in Electronic City?**
A: Yes. AS & MS offers full doorstep repair service across Electronic City Phase 1 & 2, Hosa Road,
GK Layout, and all of South Bengaluru within 20km. The technician comes to your home or office.

**Q: Do I pay before or after the repair?**
A: You pay ONLY after the repair is complete and you are satisfied. No advance payment is taken.
The price is confirmed before work begins — no hidden charges.

**Q: How long does a mobile screen replacement take?**
A: Most screen replacements are completed in 30–45 minutes at your doorstep. Battery replacements
take 20–30 minutes. Software issues take 30–60 minutes.

**Q: Do you repair iPhones?**
A: Yes. AS & MS repairs all iPhone models — screen replacement, battery replacement, charging port,
camera, software issues. Both Android and iOS are serviced.

**Q: Is there a warranty on repairs?**
A: Yes. AS & MS provides a 6-month warranty on all repairs. If the same issue returns within the
warranty period, it is fixed again at no charge.

**Q: How do I book a repair?**
A: WhatsApp +91 96062 46512 with your device model, issue, and address. A technician will confirm
a time. You can also call the same number.

**Q: What areas do you cover in Bengaluru?**
A: All of South Bengaluru within 20km of GK Layout, Hosa Road, Electronic City. This includes
Bommanahalli, Chandapura, HSR Layout, BTM Layout, JP Nagar, Sarjapur Road, and more.

**Q: Can I get a SIM card activated at home?**
A: Yes. New Airtel, Jio, Vi, and BSNL connections and SIM porting are available with home KYC.

**Q: Do you fit tempered glass at home?**
A: Yes. Tempered glass is professionally fitted at home for all phone models — bubble-free,
multiple types available.

**Q: Can I sell a dead phone?**
A: Yes. AS & MS buys dead, cracked, water-damaged, and old phones of all brands. Instant payment
via UPI or cash. WhatsApp phone photos to get a quote in minutes.
